Hi Amy / Ben —

Thanks again for the time last week. To make the renewal + expansion QBR productive for both execs and technical teams, Id like to propose splitting the session into two focused half-days next month:

- Day 1 (90 min exec + 60 min roadmap deep-dive): product roadmap, commercial terms, success metrics
- Day 2 (3-hour hands-on labs): live model workshop, integration checklist, performance tuning session

This split keeps the executives' calendar lighter while giving your engineers a dedicated window for the lab. Benefits: clearer outcomes per audience, fewer cross-talk interruptions, and we can record the exec session for any stakeholders who cant attend.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Oct 18 AM (exec), Oct 19 AM (labs)
- Option B: Oct 25 AM (exec), Oct 26 PM (labs) — backup for exec travel

I attached an agenda and the lab-environment checklist so your infra team can validate access before Day 2. Can you confirm which option works, and whether we should include a separate EMEA-friendly repeat?

Deliverables well bring: final roadmap deck, a scoped addendum for the expansion seat count, a sandbox environment snapshot (pre-provision instructions attached).

Next steps: if you confirm a date, Marissa will lock the run-of-show and David will own the lab environment pre-checks.

Thanks,
